senses.gloss: (v. next w.) to become offensive, vitiated; to decay.

units: <cite ref="Makkot 5a:9">Macc. 5ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>לענות בו סרה</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 19:16">Deut. XIX, 16</cite>) <he>עד שתַּסְרֶה גופה של עדות</he> until thou vitiatest the testimony itself (by proving an alibi of the witness himself).
